SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_season,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as boat_days,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 305 AND fish_date_doy <= 337
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  fish_date_season,
  MIN(fish_date_doy) as min_doy,
  MAX(fish_date_doy) as max_doy,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fish_date_season

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as day,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as boat_days,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(MIN(wtmp_c), 2) as min_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(MAX(wtmp_c), 2) as max_wtmp_c,
  COUNT(*) as obs_count
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 1 AND ts_doy <= 32
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy

SELECT 
  index_id,
  value,
  avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 6
ORDER BY index_id, avail_doy
